F1: The migration indexes the category query’s first result before checking whether a matching category exists, so it can crash when the setting is absent or stale.
F2: Migrated host values bypass the model’s scheme-stripping callback, so scheme-prefixed values will not match host-only lookup.
F3: The migration interpolates legacy host values into SQL without escaping, allowing a quote to break the migration or alter the statement.
F4: Validation permits ports, but lookup compares against `URI#host`, which omits the port.
F5: The hostname validation regex rejects valid domains whose suffix exceeds five characters.
F6: The tests are sparse, but a missing test alone is not a defect requiring a fix before merge.
